scope: Post-test CSL-Daily extension of native source assembly and allocation. This is a one-feature reduced learned transfer, not the PHOENIX nine-feature semantic-guard/phrase-lattice router, cross-language efficacy, or human intelligibility evidence.
historical_access: CSL-Daily and v4 donor-gloss-plan test annotations have previously been inspected. New MSKA pose scores have not been read for these branch banks. Do not describe the corpus as pristine or untouched.

evaluation.preprocessing: Frozen CSL-Daily MSKA config and tokenizer; no PHOENIX gloss cleanup; native HRNet-133 tensors unchanged; attach name/text/gloss and emitted num_frames only after prescore pose hashes.
evaluation.checkpoint_loading: Require zero missing and unexpected model keys after the documented recognition_network prefix projection.
evaluation.references: Both dev branch prediction records must have identical per-ID references, matching the declared CSL-Daily dev gloss annotation. Test annotations are unavailable to routing and fitting.
evaluation.runtime: CPU or GPU subject to measured availability; record device, versions, command, hashes, per-ID hypotheses, counts, elapsed time and peak RSS. Never silently drop samples.

learned_allocation.feature_source: v4 trace similarity from train-only word .6 / character .4 TF-IDF, fixed before MSKA scoring
learned_allocation.fit_rows: one row per development request; no trajectory replication; no test examples, labels, scores or selector targets
learned_allocation.rank: decreasing predicted y_i; exact ties use lexicographically smallest request ID
learned_allocation.candidate_lengths: training-donor or constructed-local emitted lengths only; feasibility inputs, not learned features
learned_allocation.tuning: No hyperparameter, head, seed, budget, feature, or checkpoint selection from test scores; retain the declared model even for a negative result.

order: Hash this declaration before any new MSKA pose evaluation.
Materialize and hash dev whole-replay bank using training donors; evaluate dev local and dev whole branches independently.
Fit reduced one-feature regressor from dev ensemble_last_ edit differences only.

Construct test route from test similarities and candidate lengths; write and hash scores, IDs, mask, poses, model parameters, source recipes and source certificate before evaluating any test branch bank with MSKA.
Evaluate test local and whole branches with the same frozen MSKA instance/configuration contract; compose fixed40 and reduced-learned per-item predictions by their already frozen masks.

Independently score a deterministic routed subset (first 20 test IDs in lexical order) and require exact hypothesis identity to the corresponding branch prediction on all five heads; if this fails, retain failure and directly score both full routed banks without changing the frozen routing choices.
Compute all-head corpus WER, emitted and hypothesis/reference lengths, coverage/refusal counts, paired primary contrast and source-certificate results.
primary_contrast: reduced learned fixed40 minus nonlearned fixed40 test corpus gloss-WER; negative is better
falsifier: No learned benefit if the primary WER contrast is nonnegative or its declared paired interval includes zero. A recognizer or certificate failure blocks that class of claim. Retain all null, failed and negative runs.

uncertainty.sampling_unit: normalized public query caption group; resample groups with replacement and include every utterance in a sampled group
uncertainty.normalization: v4 planner Unicode NFKC, lowercase, punctuation to spaces, collapse whitespace
uncertainty.metric: recompute ratio of total edit counts to total reference gloss tokens for each bootstrap sample

remaining_scope: Even a positive reduced transfer does not establish full PHOENIX-method equivalence, raw-video production, human CSL or DGS intelligibility, public nonrepudiation, or generalization to an untouched corpus/evaluator.
